interpretation: The interaction between Glucose and Age significantly moderates the effect on Outcome (p=0.0057), with a negative interaction coefficient (-0.00075) indicating that higher Glucose levels have a reduced positive impact on Outcome as Age increases. This finding is supported by a likelihood ratio test (chi2=7.632, p=0.0057) and bootstrap confidence intervals [-0.00129, -0.00019]. The model (Logistic Regression) achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.82 and accuracy of 0.85, outperforming Random Forest (ROC-AUC=0.79, accuracy=0.81) and XGBoost (ROC-AUC=0.80, accuracy=0.82).
